title: PR spam today looks like email spam in the early 2000s
summary: An analytical piece comparing the current state of PR spam to email spam from the early 2000s, highlighting how unsolicited outreach has become equally frustrating and prevalent in the developer relations and tech PR space.
problem_solved: Highlights the growing problem of unsolicited PR spam that clutters communication channels and wastes developers' time.
why_valuable: Serves as a cautionary observation about how marketing practices have evolved, resonating with developers who experience this spam firsthand.
